name: LIFXScreen
label: LIFX
description: Discover and control LIFX bulbs by room - power, brightness, colour, white temperature and scenes

settings.title: Enabled
settings.desc: Discover and control LIFX bulbs on this network

settings.title: Discovery Interval
settings.desc: Minutes between background scans for bulbs (default 5)

settings.title: Refresh Interval
settings.desc: Seconds between state checks while the LIFX screen is open (default 5)

settings.title: Transition Time
settings.desc: Fade time in milliseconds for power and colour changes (default 400)

settings.title: Room Source
settings.desc: Group uses the groups you named in the LIFX app (recommended). Location uses your LIFX home.

settings.title: LIFX Cloud Token
settings.desc: Optional. Personal access token from cloud.lifx.com/settings - imports the scenes you built in the LIFX app. Leave blank to use locally saved scenes only.

settings.title: Cloud Scene Sync
settings.desc: Minutes between cloud scene refreshes (default 60, 0 for startup only)

settings.title: Broadcast Address
settings.desc: Leave blank to auto-detect. Set to e.g. 192.168.1.255 if discovery misses bulbs on a segmented network.

settings.title: Reply Timeout
settings.desc: Milliseconds to wait for a bulb to reply before retrying (default 600)
